clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonefield Farm, Ma Stonefield wants Princess Must Die! before Princess ruins the harvest. The enormous prize-winning sow from Brackwell Pumpkin Patch keeps raiding the Stonefields’ vegetables, and Ma wants the family to gather their crops in peace.

Princess has put the Stonefield harvest at risk. The prize-winning sow belongs to the Brackwells, but she has grown enormous by crossing onto the Stonefield plots and devouring their vegetables. Ma Stonefield has had enough of the sow eating the crops she worked to grow. She wants Princess put down before the pig ruins the season’s yield.

Princess does not roam alone. At Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, east beyond the Maclure homestead, protective boars surround her. To prove the sow will trouble the Stonefield fields no more, you need to get past her guards and bring back the distinctive brass collar from her neck.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess. The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!
So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!
Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm. Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, friend.
Now, do either of these suit you?
